_meta.description: Long-range rifle marksman for iPhone & iPad. Second-focal-plane Christmas-tree reticle, real bullet drop out to 800 yards, walking 3D wildlife, Game Center matches, and iMessage challenges. Quiet, patient, classy.
a-real-second-focal.5c6ee4: A real second-focal-plane scope picture — etched crosshair, illuminated brass center dot, and a Christmas-tree subtension with yardage hashes from the close zero out to 800. Tap a hash to lock your holdover.
alpine-meadow-forest-clearing.d8e55e: Alpine meadow, forest clearing, coastal bluff, desert canyon. Sunrise, noon, sunset, night. Clear, rain, snow. Every match's range is uniquely seeded — no two ridgelines twice.
are-there-ads-iaps.46a41b: Are there ads, IAPs, or subscriptions?
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
distance-and-target-type.812873: Distance and target type sit on the lower-left HUD. Wind speed and direction sit on the lower-right with a rotating arrow showing exactly which way it's blowing — and a flag on the lane confirms it.
drag-while-settled-to.305aa0: Drag while settled to fine-tune your aim. The rifle responds with a touch of mass on purpose — you're squeezing a trigger, not nudging a cursor. Lift to break the shot.
eight-things-every-ridgeshot.6e8aa6: Eight things every Ridgeshot player learns to love
every-ipad-orientation-is.af32b5: Every iPad orientation is supported and the window resizes freely in Split View, Stage Manager, and iPad windowing — glass a ridge in whatever layout fits your desk.
family-friendly-content-controls.1fde92: Family-friendly content controls and a more flexible iPad experience
flatter-than-an-arrow.02121b: Flatter than an arrow, never flat. Your shot tracks a continuous-angle ballistic model from the muzzle to impact — pick the wrong holdover and the round passes high or low exactly where the tree said it would.
glance-at-the-lower.8f61c6: Glance at the lower-left HUD for the range — say "412 yd." Look at the vertical stadia under the crosshair: each hash is labelled in yards. Tap the 400 hash to lock it as your aim point, then place that hash on the heart (or the X-ring). If wind is pushing left, drift your hold a touch right so the round walks back to centre. Same idea as real long-range glass — your eye lives on the target, the tree does the math.
how-do-i-read.1d682d: How do I read the Christmas-tree reticle?
ipad-any-way-you.3a62ad: iPad, Any Way You Hold It
iphone-and-ipad-universal.6b4998: iPhone and iPad. Universal app — same purchase covers both. The game is portrait-only because the FOV crunch, reticle subtension spacing, and follow-cam waypoints are tuned for a vertical aspect. Built and tuned on iPhone 17 Pro Max; runs smoothly back to iPhone 12 and any iPad with iOS 17 or later.
live-wind-speed-and.641867: Live wind speed and heading on the HUD. A flag on the lane confirms it. Hold too long and your reticle starts to wander — controlled breath, clean break, or wait for the next pass. Your call.
long-range-rifle-marksman.0faa9b: Long-range rifle marksman in your pocket. A second-focal-plane Christmas-tree reticle, real bullet drop out to 800 yards, walking 3D wildlife, and 1v1 matches you can send through a Messages bubble. Quiet, patient, classy.
no-ridgeshot-is-a.e60b7b: No. Ridgeshot is a one-time purchase. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions. You get every range, every target, every weather state, both online flows, and all five leaderboards.
no-tracking-no-ads.9ce4d2: No tracking. No ads. No in-app purchases.
olympic-concentric-ring-targets.e4494c: Olympic concentric-ring targets, or 3D whitetail, elk, turkey, and boar that wander through the scene with their own gait and pauses. Sometimes a trunk slides into your sight picture — that's the wilderness reading right.
open-a-conversation-in.69ee20: Open a conversation in Messages, tap the Ridgeshot iMessage app, pick a format (Quickfire / Classic / Long Course) and a target style (Olympic paper / 3D wildlife), then send. Your friend taps the bubble, takes a single round, and sends the updated bubble back. Each round is one bubble — like Wordle, but for marksmen. The match lives entirely in your thread.
pass-and-play-works.1093fd: Pass-and-play works the same way on a single device. Two shooters, one screen, alternating turns. The kind of match you can finish on a porch before the sun is fully down.
quick-match-online-or.9b4095: Quick-match online or invite a friend. Asynchronous turn-based — your opponent shoots when they're free, you shoot when you're free. Push notifications keep you in sync without keeping you tethered.
ridgeshot-isn-t-sold.6656ea: Ridgeshot isn't sold on the App Store in the European Union — under the EU Digital Services Act, selling there requires publishing a trader listing with personal contact details, which I've opted out of as an independent developer. It's available in every other App Store territory.
send-a-ridgeshot-bubble.14146f: Send a Ridgeshot bubble. Your friend opens it inside Messages, takes their shot from inside the bubble, and sends it back. No app to install on their end — just the iMessage extension, which downloads silently the first time someone receives a match from you.
send-a-ridgeshot-bubble.f3c2b6: Send a Ridgeshot bubble to a friend. They open it, take their shot, send it back. Each turn is one round. The whole match lives in your conversation — no app switch, no sign-in.
that-s-natural-sway.6ce413: That's natural sway — pulse, breath, fatigue, and a rifle that weighs more than your forearm. The longer you hold, the wider your reticle wanders. Break the shot at the natural pause between breaths, or wait, settle again, and try the next cycle. Snap-shooters can lift early for a quick break; precision shooters can hold longer for a tighter window if they trust their settle. Both work — pick your style.
the-3d-animals-mode.660671: The 3D Animals mode now unlocks only after a one-time, system-verified adult age check — younger players get the full game with Olympic, Steel Plates, and Bottle Blast. Online and iMessage matches respect the setting on both sides, so animal targets can never be slipped into a match with an unverified player.
the-christmas-tree-gives.073d27: The Christmas tree gives you yardage hashes from 100 out to 800. Tap the one that matches your range, place it on the heart or the X, and let the wind decide if you need to drift a little. That last decision is the whole game.
total-wins-longest-confirmed.4da08f: Total wins, longest confirmed shot, season high score, rolling accuracy, and Olympic 10-ring count. Five different ways to be measurably better than the rest. Climb whichever one suits you.
touch-and-hold-to.ffe36c: Touch and hold to shoulder the rifle — the wood stock comes up, the support hand finds the forend, the scope picture zooms to a 10° FOV (the actual angular span of a long-range optic), and the reticle settles into your view.
what-devices-does-it.b7b7b0: What devices does it run on?
why-does-my-reticle.ea9a33: Why does my reticle drift while I'm holding?
yes-pass-and-play.81d0c1: Yes — pass-and-play is fully offline. Two shooters, one device, no sign-in. Game Center matchmaking and iMessage challenges obviously need a connection to relay turns, but the whole simulation — ballistics, wind, animals, weather — runs on-device. No server round-trips per shot, no waiting for a leaderboard sync to take your next round.
